title: 语言模型如何处理否定
summary: 研究LLM处理否定的机制：模型内部存在正确处理否定的组件，但后期注意力层倾向于简单捷径导致错误。通过消融这些注意力模块可大幅提升否定问题的准确率。模型采用两种机制：抑制相关概念和构建否定短语的表示，其中构建机制更突出。
summary_en: We study how LLMs process negation mechanistically. Models have internal components that correctly handle negation, but late-layer attention promotes shortcuts causing errors. Ablating those modules improves accuracy. Two mechanisms are used: suppressing related concepts and constructing negative phrase representations, with the latter being more prominent.
